# Commit Message Conventions

When generating commit messages, follow this format combining gitmoji emoticons with conventional commits.
Also use a list for the descripton, each description on its own line

**Format:** `<gitmoji> <type>(scope): <description>`

## Gitmoji Reference

- ✨ `:sparkles:` - New features
- 🐛 `:bug:` - Bug fixes
- 🎨 `:art:` - Code structure/format improvements
- ⚡️ `:zap:` - Performance improvements
- 🔧 `:wrench:` - Configuration changes
- 📝 `:memo:` - Documentation
- ✅ `:white_check_mark:` - Tests
- 🚀 `:rocket:` - Deployments
- ♻️ `:recycle:` - Refactoring
- 🔥 `:fire:` - Removing code/files
- 💄 `:lipstick:` - UI/styling
- 🔒 `:lock:` - Security fixes
- 🚨 `:rotating_light:` - Fixing linter warnings
- 💚 `:green_heart:` - CI/CD fixes
- 📦 `:package:` - Dependencies/packages
- 🏗️ `:building_construction:` - Architecture changes
- 🧪 `:test_tube:` - Experimental features
- 🩹 `:adhesive_bandage:` - Simple fixes
- 🔀 `:twisted_rightwards_arrows:` - Merging branches
